items.quote: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
items.claim: Abraham hurried into the tent and told Sarah to quickly prepare three measures of fine meal, knead it, and bake cakes on the hearth.
items.action: told Sarah to quickly make cakes from fine meal
items.object: three measures of fine meal made into cakes
items.mechanism: food prepared quickly at home on the hearth: meal measured, kneaded, and baked as cakes
